description: A sprite sheet of SIX separate farm animal buildings and items arranged in a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows, each centered in its own cell. Top row: a small wooden chicken coop with a ramp and a straw nest box, a small wooden cow barn stall with a hay rack, a wooden beehive box on a little stand with honeycomb visible. Bottom row: a wooden feeding trough with hay, a basket of brown and white eggs, a metal milk can with a bucket of milk. Front view, slight top-down, thick dark outline, soft cel shading, warm natural colors, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with empty space around it, no ground, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no animals, no border, no frame
style_usage: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view, one object centered in each cell. Do not copy these objects, their colors or their layout.
